description.narrative: The objectives of the Education Modernization Project for Belarus are to: (i) improve access to quality learning environment in selected general secondary schools; and (ii) strengthen student assessment and education management information systems of the Republic of Belarus. There are three components to the project, the first component being ensuring a quality learning environment in schools receiving students from closed and reorganized schools. The objective of this component is to provide a learning environment that is conducive to quality education in selected schools. The second component is the modernization of system management in general secondary education. The objective of this component is to facilitate the use of international best practices in assessing the quality of education and using data analysis for education system management. Finally, the third component is the project implementation support. The objective of this component is to ensure adequate support for the implementation of the project activities. To this end, the project will finance consultant services, training directly related to project implementation, financial audit, and selected operating expenses. The majority of operating costs of a Project Implementation Unit (PIU) housed within the National Institute of Education (NIE) will be financed using Republican budget funds. These may include, among others, salaries of staff members engaged in Project implementation, social insurance contributions, purchase of consumables, business trip expenses, communication expenses, utility costs, other current expenses, purchases of software and computer hardware, and so forth.

The objectives of the proposed Project are to: (i) improve access to a quality learning environment in selected general secondary education institutions; and (ii) strengthen the Belarus' student assessment and education management information systems.

title.narrative: Number of education managers trained in the use of the integrated EMIS

comment.narrative: IRI 17.1. P2: Not Achieved: No education managers were trained in the use of the integrated EMIS (0 percent level of achievement with respect to the AF target of 7,210).
IRI 19. P2: Not Achieved: One large-scale primary/secondary learning assessment was completed with the operation's support (50 percent level of achievement with respect to the AF target of 2).

title.narrative: Number of schools that received innovative teaching and learning clusters on science subjects (Physics, Chemistry, Computer Science, Biology)

comment.narrative: IRI 9. P2: Not Achieved: One GSE school received innovative teaching and learning clusters on science subjects—i.e., physics, chemistry, computer science, and biology (5 percent level of achievement with respect to the AF target of 21).

title.narrative: Number of education managers that received training and capacity building in modernization of the education system

comment.narrative: IRI 18.1. P2: Not Achieved: A total of 100 education managers received training and capacity building in the modernization of the education system (6 percent level of achievement with respect to the AF target of 1,770).

title.narrative: Number of schools supplied with laboratory equipment under the project (either one or a combination of Physics, Chemistry, Computer Science, Biology)

comment.narrative: IRI 14. P1: Achieved; P2: Not Achieved: A total of 129 GSE schools were supplied with laboratory equipment under the project--either one or a combination of physics, chemistry, computer science, and biology (108 percent and 46 percent level of achievement with respect to the original target of 120 and the upwardly revised AF target of 279, respectively).

title.narrative: Number of schools rehabilitated under the project to meet minimum conditions for a quality learning environment

comment.narrative:
KOI 3. P1: Exceeded: A total of 175 GSE schools were rehabilitated to meet minimum conditions for a quality learning environment (146 percent level of achievement with respect to the original target of 120).
IRI 1. P2: Not Achieved: A total of 175 GSE schools were rehabilitated to meet minimum conditions for a quality learning environment (58 percent level of achievement with respect to the upwardly revised AF target of 300).

title.narrative: Number of rehabilitated schools targeted by the project, providing social and cultural services to the population

comment.narrative: IRI 11. P2: Largely Achieved: A total of 18 rehabilitated GSE schools are providing social and cultural services to the population (86 percent level of achievement with respect to the AF target of 21).

title.narrative: Students benefiting from direct interventions to enhance learning
Students benefitting from an improved learning environment in general secondary schools targeted by the project

comment.narrative: KOI 1.1. P1: Exceeded; P2: Partially Achieved: A total of 54,682 students benefited from an improved learning environment in participating GSE schools (219 percent and 84 percent of achievement with respect to the original target of 25,000 and the upwardly revised AF target of 65,000, respectively).

title.narrative: Percent of beneficiaries reporting that community center activities represented the views of the community, students, and teachers

comment.narrative: IRI 20. P2: Achieved: 90.2 percent of beneficiaries reported that community center activities represented the views of the community, students, and teachers (113 percent level of achievement with respect to the AF target of 80).

title.narrative: Percent of school users who consider that the project implementation responded to their views

comment.narrative: IRI 21. P2: Achieved: 94 percent of school users considered that the operation's implementation responded to their views (117 percent level of achievement with respect to the AF target of 80).

title.narrative: Beneficiaries reporting improved satisfaction with the quality of learning environment, relative to an appropriate control group

target.value: Satisfaction is statistically higher in the treatment schools than in control schools

comment.narrative: KOI 4. P1 and IRI 13. P2: Achieved: Beneficiaries (i.e., students, teachers, and parents) in participating GSE schools consistently reported higher levels of satisfaction with the quality of the learning environment relative to their peers in the control group.

actual.value: According to the annual survey by the Ministry of Education, the Project interventions have a positive impact on beneficiaries' satisfaction with schools' learning conditions. All details are provided in the comments.

title.narrative: Improved national system of education quality assessment

baseline.value: Existing sample-based national assessment system in place

target.value: Assessment of the quality of education with new tools conducted.

comment.narrative: IRI 15. P1 & P2: Partially Achieved There has been significant progress toward strengthening the national education quality assessment system with new tools (textbook analysis, new items development, psychometric analysis of new items, etc.). The national sample-based assessment was also improved and is being implemented utilizing a nationally representative sample of students. In 2023 the Government launched a new national research on education quality (national assessment of learning outcomes) that is aligned with PISA domains and focused on the application of knowledge by students.

actual.value: A toolkit for psychological examination of textbooks for general secondary education institutions and a matrix for a comprehensive assessment of teaching aids for institutions of general secondary education have been developed.A long-term plan for monitoring studies has been developed. This academic year republican tests on the history of Belarus (grade 6), biology (grade 7) have been carried out. Demos have been developed for the tests. A new model of the republican monitoring of the quality of education has been developed.

title.narrative: Analytical work on PISA research results in the Republic of Belarus completed

target.value: Developed recommendations for the development of educational policies and national assessment based on the results of PISA 2021 research. A comparative analysis of the results of 2018 and 2021 carried out

comment.narrative: IRI 16. P2: Not Achieved: Analytical work on PISA 2018 research results has been completed. Belarus' participation in PISA 2021 was suspended.

actual.value: Multicomponent analysis of the official results of the PISA 2018 study in the Republic of Belarus was carried out. The report has been published and posted in the public domain on the Internet on the National Educational Portal. Recommendations have been developed for the development of educational policy and the assessment of the quality of general secondary education based on the results of the PISA 2018.

title.narrative: Annual education statistics reports produced using data generated by the integrated EMIS

target.value: Annual report produced with100% of its data generated by EMIS

comment.narrative: KOI 6. P1 & P2: Not Achieved: While an integrated EMIS covering all levels of education was designed with the operation's support, its implementation is still pending. Thus, annual education statistics reports are not produced using data generated by the newly developed EMIS.

actual.value: The development of EMIS has been suspended. Only three stages out of six planned for the development of EMIS for secondary education have been completed. Contracts have been terminated.

title.narrative: Republic of Belaruss participation in PISA is supported

target.value: Belarus participate in PISA 2018, 2022, and initiated participation in PISA 2025. All results are published for Belarus

comment.narrative: KOI 5. P1: Achieved; P2: Partially Achieved: While Belarus participated in PISA 2018. A robust set of policy recommendations for enhancing the country's GSE performance arose from an in-depth analysis of 2018 PISA. The GoB also planned to participate in PISA 2021, OECD suspended its collaboration with Belarus after the imposition of sanctions. Belarus joined PISA 2021 and implemented the piloting phase of this study, before cancellation by the OECD.

actual.value: Belarus participated in PISA 2019 and published its results. Trial phase of PISA 2022 testing was carried out in 76 institutions in April-May 2021. The main stage of PISA 2022 was not conducted in Belarus due to the termination of the agreement at the initiativef the OECD. Belarus was not registered for PISA 2024 due to the refusal of the OECD.

title.narrative: Impact evaluation study on the progress of project schools in the improvement of quality of learning environment and its use as per the international study on learning environments is conducted

target.value: According to international methodology, project schools apply successful elements of the intervention and show better progress as compared to the control group.

comment.narrative: KOI 7. P2: Not Achieved: The first of a two-part impact evaluation study was completed. It defined the baseline to measure progress of participating GSE schools in the improvement of quality of learning environment and its use in line with the results of the international study on learning environments.

actual.value: A baseline study of the assessment of the quality of the educational environment in 154 educational institutions participating in the Project and in the control group was carried out. The final report has been presented.
